global_caption: It adopts a low-saturation cyberpunk visual style throughout, dominated by cool blue and dark purple tones. A grainy snow curtain continuously engulfs the medieval magic castle. Camera movement progresses from slow establishment to tight tracking, then emotional push-in. Lighting relies primarily on diffuse cold light from the blizzard and localized neon side-backlighting.
shot1: Shot 1 opens with a fade-in from black, using a wide overhead composition: foreground features blurred gray-white snowstorm, midground shows layered ascending castle walls and spires, background reveals mountains swallowed by snow fog. Focus first lands on flickering neon runes in the blizzard, then captures an eagle flying across the tower top from the upper right, its wings slicing through the snow curtain creating clear motion. The environment maintains a wet, cold, gritty texture; ice coats the tower surfaces, and neon runes intermittently flash on stone like ancient magical sigils. As the eagle soars, it slightly opens its beak to chant '눈보라여, 잠든 성을 지켜줘', the The camera performs a slow overhead pan with slight follow, establishing setting while naturally introducing the protagonist into the next shot.
shot2: Shot 2 follows with a hard cut, switching to eye-level close-up tracking. Composition places the icy battlement diagonally in the foreground, the eagle perched at the top left focal point, background blurred with snowstorm and flashing runes, emphasizing feather texture and ice details. Shallow depth of field, side light from the back-left outlines the damp feathers with faintly glowing edges; tiny ice particles on the feathers reflect low-saturation neon, emitting subtle cold glimmers. The eagle folds wings, grips the ice firmly, chest rises and falls, beak opens and closes clearly continuing to chant '길 잃은 빛도 다시 날게 해', each Korean syllable synchronized with minute movements of beak and neck muscles. After landing, tail feathers tremble slightly, claws press into ice leaving faint scratches. Wind occasional distant metallic flag chains creaking in the wind add ambient detail. The camera first tracks horizontally briefly, then slowly pushes in, enhancing intimacy with the subject and building toward emotional climax.
shot3: Shot 3 enters via a brief snow-obscured transition, using a low-angle close-up. Viewpoint looks upward from beneath the eagle’s chest: foreground features wind-blown snowflakes, midground shows wings spread against the wind, background displays the mountain path completely buried under snow, only undulating contours visible, with blurred tower tips barely discernible. Composition fills both sides of frame with wings, forming a visually oppressive and solemn peak. Lighting continues the cool base tone but with stronger backlight, making feather edges appear outlined in cold neon; snow particles brushing past wingtips create fine sparkling points. In strong wind, the eagle lifts head, spreads wings, stabilizes body; feathers flare up then pressed down by wind. Then it holds this pose, the final note fading into wind. In the last second, the mountain path is fully swallowed by thicker snow, completing environmental and emotional resolution.
